title: Special Topics in Bioengineering (M.Eng.); Applications of Bioinformatics
description:
For Master of Engineering students only or with permission of department.

This course will discuss quantitating biomedical and bioinformatics data. Analysis based on uni-variate and bi-variate methods in both time and frequency domains will be covered. Statistical significance of the linkages will also be discussed. A matrix-based approach will be used to understand the linkages in a network and to solve differential equations. Application of singular value decomposition will be discussed to reduce the noise and to identify biologically relevant genes. All the programming will be done in MATLAB programming language.
